mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 32 degrees and clear near Harriet Park under a full moon.

The City of Verona reminds residents that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the holiday. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection scheduled for Thursday will be pushed to Friday, November 27.

We have plenty going on in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and a special 50th-anniversary craft brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding local public safety, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle; she was later arrested for O W I.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's flavor, which is Butter Pecan. The Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
